verdict.rationale: Gusto provides an extensively documented public REST API (Embedded Payroll) covering onboarding, payroll runs, contractor payments, time off, webhooks, pagination, idempotency, and versioning, plus llms.txt-formatted docs and an official MCP server for AI tools to interact directly with the API. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of API usage by an AI agent beyond vendor docs.
